CLEAN_CAPABILITY_SOURCE.definition: Source whose semantics are project-neutral capability/mechanism data and contain no legacy MiniTZ behavioral/control authority.
process: local AI bounded extraction/comparison when useful
merge only into the existing semantic owner; never create a parallel mechanism

MINITZ_BEHAVIOR_BEARING_SOURCE.definition: Any source containing MiniTZ-era control policy, agent hierarchy, approval/review gates, resource restrictions, liveness rules, memory/routing authority, hardware/provider assumptions, or self-modification behavior.
process: line/concept mapping against current 00/01/03/04/06/07 + live implementation
explicit classification for every extracted rule
reject or clean-reimplement; never copy/rename active
